title: HOW TO BREAK OFF AN ENGAGEMENT
lines: How to break off an engagement is a library of stacks.
It keeps 1,000 shots from 57 films. Every film is a tower, every shot a floor, every frame a window.
Its 7 streets are the scenes of the poem, in order: the first is “Tambourine tumbles in black”.
The tallest tower is The Green Promise (1949): 36 floors.
Nothing in it is older than 1917 or newer than 2020.
The sign most often read here is sonsign.
